messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera directly, her mouth moving slightly as if speaking or lip-syncing, while her expression remains relatively neutral.","camera":"The shot is a medium close-up that slowly zooms in on her face over the duration of the clip.","clothing":"She wears a bright pink, off-the-shoulder top.","hair_color":"Light brown with blonde highlights.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in two high buns on either side of her head, with straight bangs covering her forehead and longer strands framing her face.","identity":"A young woman with a medium-brown complexion, full lips, and visible freckles across her cheeks and nose.","scene":"The background is a futuristic, neon-lit environment featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue lighting, and a circular glowing ring above."},"uncertain":[]}}

raw_output:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>
Change only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>
The output replaces the source's side-view full-body walking shot with a front-facing medium close-up of the woman's face and upper chest. The camera slowly pushes in over the clip, and her mouth moves slightly. The futuristic dome background remains, but the original walking motion and full-body framing are no longer visible.</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>
partial
</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>["The source action of walking across the scene is not preserved; the subject is now nearly stationary facing the camera.", "The original full-body framing and side profile are replaced by a front close-up, so the requested camera-only change also altered the visible action and framing.", "The top appears off-the-shoulder in the close-up, whereas the source showed a fitted long-sleeve top; this may be due to the new angle but is not clearly consistent."]]
</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Whether the facial expression and subtle action timing were preserved from the source cannot be fully verified because the source action was not visible in the same form.", "Whether the clothing change is an unintended identity/appearance change or merely a consequence of the new front-facing framing is uncertain."]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

function.description: Record only source/output comparison and instruction fulfillment. The independently observed output card cannot be modified.
function.name: record_edit_result
